gates.advantage: The hidden larder behind the back wall: two seasons of dried meat and a spare torch cache.
gates.sign: Light shows the crack. Carry a torch, enter free.

gates.advantage: The sealed granary bypass: skip the toll yard and arrive with reserves intact.
gates.sign: Eight measures of grain open this door.

gates.advantage: The legion cache beyond the gate: bronze gear at quartermaster prices.
gates.sign: A bronze sword speaks pass. Enter unarmed, pay.

gates.advantage: The scriptorium undercroft: copied texts that shorten the era's knowledge decay.
gates.sign: Show eight of faith. The brothers admit believers.

gates.advantage: Rung bell: the era-6 merchant stocks torches you couldn't otherwise afford.
gates.sign: Rang the bell? The bell-tower door is yours.

gates.advantage: The charter factor's shortcut: cleared papers, no anchorage quarantine.
gates.sign: Ten coin buys the factor's cleared papers.

gates.advantage: The deputation lane: past the pickets and straight to the drafting room.
gates.sign: Citizens of standing pass. Legitimacy eight, shown.

gates.advantage: The company siding: freight passage without the navvy toll or the walk.
gates.sign: Company men only. Present scrip, ride the siding.

gates.advantage: The bank road: preferred routing past the checkpoint line, quarter after quarter.
gates.sign: Credit of ten gets the bank road. Cash waits.

gates.advantage: The priority corridor: requisition transport, rations, and a mapped route.
gates.sign: Priority corridor. Stamped ration book required.

gates.advantage: The hardened route: fallout-sheltered way through with the crossing kit.
gates.sign: Mask on past this point. No mask, no passage.

gates.advantage: The contractor lane: launch traffic, clear of the queue and the cameras.
gates.sign: Contractor badge admits one. Visitors queue.

gates.advantage: The fiber shed cut-through: an unmetered line and a head start on the decade.
gates.sign: Badge the chip, take the fiber shed cut-through.

gates.advantage: The transition lane: grid-side passage and a market-rate price on your carbon.
gates.sign: Transition lane: ten carbon credits, verified.

gates.advantage: The verified gate: fast lane past the mob, identity pre-cleared.
gates.sign: Verified identities only. Show the seal, pass.

gates.advantage: The thaw roster: early wake-cycle and the reserve stores that go with it.
gates.sign: Resolve eight qualifies for the thaw roster.

gates.advantage: The solvent list: standing terms with the Consortia and first call on good orbits.
gates.sign: Solvent selves only. Selfhood ten, notarized.
